title: ¡Tito come espagueti con la trompa! 🍝🐘 | #shorts
world: sunny garden patio for lunch: a little round table with a red-and-white checkered tablecloth under a yellow striped umbrella, lemon trees in big terracotta pots, a white wall with climbing flowers
story: Tito sucks a long spaghetti strand up his trunk like a straw, slurp! Red sauce flies everywhere (funny problem, second 0)
Extreme close-up: sauce on his face, his ears and his overalls, spaghetti on his head (consequence)
Mamá Elefanta gently wipes his face with a napkin (mentor, no scolding)
Top-down on the plate: Mamá's trick, the little fork turns and turns and makes a neat spaghetti ball (the trick)
Close-up: Tito takes a neat bite from the fork, mouth closed, he smiles (he learns)
Tito proudly holds up his clean empty plate (reward)
Tito and Mamá eat together neatly at the checkered table, both with forks (moral)
One last spaghetti strand on the plate: Tito looks around, winks, and slurps it up his trunk (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Slurp, slurp! ¡Espagueti con la trompa!
[Verse]
¡Uy! ¡Salsa por todos lados!
Mamá le limpia la carita.
Gira y gira el tenedor.
¡Ñam! Un bocado limpiecito.
[Chorus]
¡Plato limpio! ¡Gracias, mamá!
¡En la mesa, con tenedor!
[Outro]
¿Uno más? ¡Slurp!

locations.patio: A sunny garden patio at lunchtime, outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a little round table with a red-and-white checkered tablecloth under a big yellow-and-white striped umbrella, two small wooden chairs, lemon trees with bright yellow lemons in big terracotta pots, a white garden wall with climbing pink flowers, warm sunlight and a wide open blue sky. Nobody is on the patio.

shots: Wide shot of the sunny garden patio: the baby elephant sits at the little round table with the red-and-white checkered tablecloth and sucks one long spaghetti strand up into his trunk like a straw, little drops of red tomato sauce flying in the air around the plate of spaghetti.
He slurps the long spaghetti strand up his trunk and little sauce drops fly around.

Extreme close-up of the baby elephant's face at the table: his cheeks, his trunk and his big ears now COVERED IN RED TOMATO SAUCE spots, two spaghetti strands draped over his head, his eyes wide with a surprised grin, red sauce spots on his yellow overalls.
A spaghetti strand slides slowly off his head and he blinks in surprise.

Medium shot, side view at the checkered table: Mamá Elefanta smiling leans over and gently wipes the baby elephant's sauce-covered cheek with a white cloth napkin held in her trunk, the baby elephant closing his eyes and giggling.
Mamá gently wipes his cheek with the napkin and he giggles.

Top-down view from above the white plate of spaghetti with red tomato sauce on the checkered tablecloth: a small rounded children's fork stands in the middle of the spaghetti, turning and wrapping the strands into a neat round spaghetti ball, the baby elephant's trunk tip holding the fork handle.
The little fork turns round and round and the spaghetti wraps into a neat ball.

Close-up three-quarter view at the table: the baby elephant, his face now CLEAN and shiny, takes a neat bite of a small spaghetti ball from the little fork held in his trunk, his mouth closed, eyes happy, lemon trees blurred behind.
He takes the neat bite from the fork and chews happily with his mouth closed.

Low front view from the tabletop: the baby elephant with a clean face proudly holds up his EMPTY clean white plate with both hands above the checkered tablecloth, a big proud smile, sunshine sparkles around the plate.
He lifts the empty plate up proudly and his smile grows.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind Mamá Elefanta at the checkered table: across the table the baby elephant and Mamá both eat spaghetti neatly with little forks, the big yellow striped umbrella above them, lemon trees around.
Both lift their forks with neat spaghetti balls and smile at each other.
Close-up, low angle at the edge of the table: one last long spaghetti strand lies on the empty plate, the baby elephant looks sideways with a cheeky wink and his trunk tip reaches toward the strand.
He winks and his trunk sneaks toward the last spaghetti strand.
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.
twist: only an elephant can eat spaghetti like a straw — the trunk-slurp is the funny mistake, and Mamá's fork-twirl trick turns the mess into a neat spaghetti ball you see from above
experiment: first table-manners/mealtime video, riding the fastest-growing topic of 21.10 (El Tren Ñam-Ñam manners +7.1M and VocaVoca mealtime +6.9M since the 20.10 scan); one location only (all-patio) to test whether a single bright world + many angles is enough
continuity: sunny lunchtime in every shot; checkered tablecloth + yellow striped umbrella in every shot; sauce on Tito's face/ears/overalls M1-M3 (COVERED in M2), face CLEAN from M5 on (overall spots may stay); plate full M1-M4, EMPTY M6 and M8 (one strand in M8); small rounded fork from M4 on; napkin only M3; Mamá only in M3 and M7
